impl.summary: Re-read all four fal kling/v4 OpenAPI schemas on 2026-11-01. I extended scripts/fetch-hosted-schemas.py with --part4 (refreshes research part 4's records in place) and fixed its parser to keep min/maxLength and fal's file limits. All four endpoints are status active in fal's catalog, and their llms.txt pages show fal.run endpoints with no 'coming soon'; I flipped the records to active with checked=2026-11-01. I also read Replicate's official kwaivgi/kling-v4.0 (version f4dc4504, 2026-10-26) and added it as a second provider for t2v, i2v and flf2v only. Those map cleanly. Its references (numbered @image_1 across start, middle, end and reference images) and edits stay on fal, because Replicate has no shots or elements. The kling-4 model is generated with t2v, i2v+flf2v, ref2v, v2v, video-swap and video-insert; the Kling family's existing last-frame extend applies automatically. Badges are top, 30s and new. Defaults are 1080p, 5 s, 16:9; it takes any whole second from 3 to 30, and aspect ratios 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 21:9 and auto. In the Video studio's Best list it sits right after Seedance 2.5. Shots map to multi_prompt (whole seconds, each prompt cut to 512 characters, the take as long as its shots), so a 30 s Cinema take is one call. @mentioned characters and props become Kling elements (@Element1..: a photo plus up to 3 angles, or a clip as a video element); locations and styles stay reference images. The mention menu says 'voices: not yet'. Edits, reference clips and clip elements are priced with a new Pricing.clipInput rule: max(input + output, 2x output) seconds at $0.094/$0.141 per second. The plan prices runs with clips at that minimum until the server reads the clip headers, then re-prices. Edit video's picker shows '$0.141/sec in+out', and a line under the composer says what is billed before the total (e.g. '4 s in + 4 s out: billed on 8 s at $0.141/s'). The clip limits (3-30 s, 700-4553 px a side, 30 s of clips in all) are checked in the composer and on the server before any paid call. Kling 4.0's edit is listed in Genjutsu's Object swap and Insert (prompt uses @Video1 and @Image1..). Cinema offers kling-4 after Seedance 2.5. I fixed the keyframes.ts comment so it no longer promises Kling keyframes. The licence row comes out automatically as 'Paid API · fal, Replicate' (Kuaishou), switched on.

findings.title: Multi-shot: each shot's own words are cut off when the overall prompt is long (512-character cut keeps the wrong end)
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/payload.ts clipWords() + buildPayload multiShot branch; src/lib/catalog/plan.ts:384
findings.detail: planGeneration puts the overall prompt in front of every native shot (`${overall}. ${shot}`). The new maxPrompt rule then cuts that joined text to 512 characters from the start. With an overall prompt of about 500 characters or more (a detailed prompt, Cinema's compiled prompt, or the @mention legend added to it), every shot's own instruction is lost and all shots go to fal with the same text. The top-level prompt is deleted when multi_prompt is sent, so the shot words appear nowhere.
findings.verified: Probe (planCinema kling-4, three manual shots, a 524-character prompt) -> planGeneration -> buildPayload on the fal route. Every multi_prompt entry was 509 characters, identical, and contained none of the shot text (SHOT-ONE/TWO/THREE). With a 17-character prompt the shots kept their words. The package's test only uses a short overall prompt.
findings.fix: Keep the shot's words first: cut the overall part to fit (512 minus the shot's length minus 2), or skip the prefix when it doesn't fit. Add a test with a 600-character overall prompt.

findings.title: 'Auto' aspect ratio is offered for text-to-video and sent to endpoints that reject it
findings.where: scripts/gen-cloud-models.py (kling-4 has no fit_values) -> options.aspectRatios includes 'auto'; payload.ts putEnum
findings.detail: Only kling/v4/reference-to-video takes aspect_ratio 'auto'. fal's text-to-video enum and Replicate's kwaivgi/kling-v4.0 enum are only 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 21:9. The fal enum was re-checked live today. The model's options merge all routes, so the Video studio's aspect picker shows 'Auto' for a text-only run. buildPayload then sends aspect_ratio:'auto' unchanged to fal text-to-video and to Replicate, and both answer 422.
findings.verified: settingsShape(kling-4,'t2v').aspect = [16:9,9:16,1:1,21:9,auto]. planGeneration with params.aspectRatio='auto' gives a fal t2v payload with aspect_ratio 'auto' and a Replicate payload with 'auto'. Live fal OpenAPI V4TextToVideoInput.aspect_ratio enum = ['16:9','9:16','1:1','21:9'].
findings.fix: Pass fit_values=True for kling-4, or give the t2v and Replicate routes an `accepts` list, so 'auto' is dropped or fitted. Add a payload test for 'auto' on t2v.

findings.title: Shot lengths: totals under 3 s pass the planner; rounding can change the total; Replicate gets a fractional duration
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/payload.ts (ms.integer rounding, duration = sum of rounded shots); plan.ts multi-shot check
findings.detail: The planner only checks the maximum. The Video studio's shot editor lets shots go down to 1 s, so two 1 s shots send duration 2, below fal's minimum of 3, and get a 422. Each shot is rounded on its own, so the sent total can differ from the priced total (2.4+2.4 is priced at 4.8 s and sent as 4 s), and could go above 30 s in an edge case. When a run with fractional shots goes to Replicate (written-out shots), duration 4.8 is sent to an integer field. The UI uses whole seconds, so this is reached mainly through the API or agent.
findings.verified: Probe: shots [1,1] -> fal payload duration 2. Shots [2.4,2.4] -> plan duration 4.8 (priced $1.128), fal shots [2,2] with duration 4, Replicate duration 4.8.
findings.fix: Refuse shots that total under 3 s for kling-4, and round so the total is kept (largest remainder), or round when planning so the price and the payload match.

findings.title: Some of the hosted API's input limits aren't checked before the paid call
findings.detail: Not checked before the paid call: a video element's clip must be 3-8 s; the edit's aspect ratio must be 0.40-2.50 and its frame rate 23.9-60.05 fps; the edit takes up to 4 video_urls, but options.maxVideos is 5, from ref2v. On the server, clipWindowProblem and clipSizeProblem run only for op v2v and only when params.duration is unset. Genjutsu swap/insert checks the sides and length on the client. None of these get past fal's own validation, but they fail with a raw provider error rather than Fuobe's words.
findings.verified: Read the code paths. The research records state the limits.
findings.fix: Optional follow-up: add the element-clip and aspect/fps checks next to clipSizeProblem.

findings.title: Edit video shows Aspect, Duration and Multi-shot controls that Kling 4.0's edit ignores
findings.detail: For op v2v, settingsShape reads the model-wide options, so Kling 4.0's edit shows aspect (including auto), durations 3-30 and multi-shot. The edit route sends none of these: it keeps the source clip's length and shape. Kling O3 behaves the same way before this package, so this is not a new regression. It is at odds with the owner's 'say plainly what each engine does'.

review.verdict: changes-requested: the catalog, pricing, elements, edits and sign-up handling are sound and match the schemas, but three things need fixing before merge. (1) Multi-shot runs lose each shot's own prompt when the overall prompt is long. (2) 'Auto' aspect is offered for and sent to text-to-video endpoints that reject it. (3) tests/open-minimax-h3.test.ts fails with the new Best list. Rebase onto the current base as well (trivial composer.tsx conflict).

applied: HIGH multi-shot prompt cut: planGeneration now puts the shot's own words first wherever a route caps shot prompts (FieldMap.multiShot.maxPrompt, Kling 4.0: 512). The overall prompt in front is cut at a word to the room left, and left out when fewer than 40 characters fit. payload.ts clipWords is exported for this. Test: a 600+ character overall prompt keeps SHOT-ONE/TWO/THREE whole, each under 512 characters and all different; a shot that fills 512 characters by itself goes alone; a short overall prompt still leads each shot.

MEDIUM 'auto' aspect: kling-4 gets fit_values=True in scripts/gen-cloud-models.py, and the catalog was regenerated (only the kling-4 block changed). Each route now lists the aspect ratios and resolutions it accepts, so 'auto' reaches only reference-to-video. fal text-to-video and Replicate leave it out and use the API's own 16:9. Test: a payload with 'auto' on t2v (fal and Replicate) passes the schema check, 9:16 is still sent to Replicate, and ref2v still gets 'auto'.
MEDIUM Best list: tests/open-minimax-h3.test.ts now expects ['minimax-h3','seedance-2-5','kling-4','kling-3']. Veo 3.1 leaving Best is intended (owner).

LOW shot lengths: new wholeShots() in plan.ts uses largest-remainder rounding to whole seconds and keeps the rounded total, so 2.4+2.4 becomes 3+2. It runs in the plan for models with integer multi-shot routes, so the priced total, the multi_prompt durations and Replicate's duration are the same whole seconds. Totals under the model's minimum (3 s) are refused ('The shots add up to 2s — Kling 4.0 makes 3s or more'), and rounding that goes past 30 s is refused too. Tests cover all of this, including the price ($0.785 for 5 s at 720p) and the schema checks on fal and Replicate.

LOW pre-call limits (clip-windows.ts): SOURCE_FRAME adds aspect 0.40–2.50 to clipSizeProblem and a new clipFpsProblem for 23.9–60.05 fps; elementClipProblem checks 3–8 s clip elements; editClipsProblem allows at most 4 reference clips in an edit, with clip elements counted separately. The plan refuses more than 4 reference clips on v2v/swap/insert. The composer's clipBlocker adds the fps check. On the server, prepClip records clip lengths by input index, so each clip element is checked against 3–8 s. A new block holds an edit whose route sends no duration (Kling 4.0's edit, swap and insert) to the window, sides, shape and fps even when the request named a length. Frame-billed VACE routes are excluded and keep the base's rule. Tests: unit tests in tests/kling-4.test.ts, and a new tests/kling-4-server.test.ts with stubbed fetch: a 3000x700 edit with duration 5 and a 10 s clip element are both refused before any kling/v4 call. That test fails without the server change.

Merged origin/claude/fuobe-parity-4 three times as it moved (dc991833, then bc458e7f with o/n7-2-layout-mode, then 4e51ffbf with o/owner-calls-1). Conflicts resolved by keeping both sides: composer.tsx uses layoutShape plus clipOutcome(..., today); clip-windows, plan, composer and generations keep the base's frame-billed VACE windows (sourceFrames/billedClipSeconds, clipWindowProblem(..., fps)) beside Kling 4.0's checks. The edit-clips check was moved so it no longer collides with the base's layout block in plan.ts.
rejected: INFO: Edit video shows Aspect/Duration/Multi-shot that Kling 4.0's edit ignores. Not changed. The review marks it informational and older than this package (Kling O3 behaves the same). Fixing it means making settingsShape route-aware for all edit models, which is outside this fix stage. The server now holds such edits to the clip's own limits whatever duration is sent.

Built but not verified live: no fal or Replicate key was available, so real payloads, billing and edit audio still need a paid call. Nothing needs a GPU. Public sign-up: guests browse only. Accounts run only on their own ComfyUI, so they cannot run Kling 4.0 on the install's keys; their clip reads go through readRef/account-inputs as before (tests/account-kling-clips.test.ts). No new routes.
